scope: Meteorological uncertainty conditional on accepted structures, physical parameters, boundaries, fixed gate histories, wetland design and initial conditions.
interpretation: Ordinary seasonal six-day windows, not annual flood probabilities. Scenario quantiles differ from Monte Carlo confidence intervals.
flood_threshold_status: No justified downstream flood threshold; no flood-exceedance probability is claimed.
attempt_count_meaning: Distinct scenario IDs with at least one actual ODE integration start. Preflight-only skips are excluded. All adapter-evaluated IDs remain in exclusion denominators.
failure_count_meaning: Scenario counts flag at least one affected case; applicability and numerical categories may overlap if the two cases have different outcomes. Case status counts count each case separately.

copula_var.benefit_tolerance_basis: Existing Stage B peak-grid screen 0.001 m, conservatively above the saved deterministic 60-to-30 s changes. Check against Stage C representative refinement; unresolved or larger error prevents millimetre-effect claims.
copula_var.benefit_classification_interpretation: Provisional descriptive classifications at the configured tolerance only. Stage C refinement is absent, incomplete, invalid or failed; improvement/worsening fractions are not established numerical effects.
copula_var.probability_readiness_note: Requires weather validation and training persistence screens, representative numerical checks, and no unaccounted applicability/numerical selection. Passing still does not establish annual or rare-tail flood accuracy.
copula_var.selection_warning: Response summaries, if available, describe completed valid pairs only. Applicability failures remain in the attempted denominator and can induce selection bias. They are not assigned zero benefit.
